name: Rancherias Plaza
summary: Rancherias Plaza is a community-oriented strip center located on Highway 18 in Apple Valley, serving High Desert residents with convenient shopping and services. With a 4-star rating from over 1,300 reviews, this open-air center provides accessible retail options for everyday needs in the growing San Bernardino County community.
demographics: Rancherias Plaza serves the Apple Valley community in the High Desert region of San Bernardino County, attracting primarily middle-income families and retirees who have relocated to this affordable suburban area. The trade area draws from a population seeking value-oriented shopping options, with household incomes typically ranging from $40,000 to $75,000 annually. Visitors are predominantly local residents conducting routine shopping trips, with a mix of young families, working-class households, and seniors who appreciate the convenient strip center format and ample parking typical of High Desert retail developments.
description: Rancherias Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center conveniently located at 20180 California Highway 18 in Apple Valley, California, serving the High Desert community of San Bernardino County. This open-air retail center provides essential shopping and services to local residents in a convenient strip center format with easy access and parking. Operating daily from 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM, Rancherias Plaza offers a practical shopping destination for Apple Valley families and residents seeking everyday goods and services. The center has earned a solid 4-star rating from over 1,300 Google reviews, reflecting its role as a reliable community shopping destination. With its location along the busy CA-18 corridor, Rancherias Plaza serves as an accessible retail hub for the growing Apple Valley area, providing convenient shopping options in the heart of the High Desert region.
